## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-2 is correct under its stated hypotheses, but the report should include the actual argument: integral Pieri gives
  \[
  h_ks_\mu=\sum_{\nu/\mu\text{ horizontal }k\text{-strip}}s_\nu,
  \]
  with out-of-box terms zero; every surviving \(\nu\) still contains \(i^j\). Thus \(h_kS\subseteq S\), and generation of \(A\) by \(h_1,\ldots,h_q\) yields \(AS\subseteq S\).
- claim-3’s scalar-extension conclusion does not follow from the stated Schur-span premise alone. It additionally requires an identified map \(\Bbbk\otimes_{\mathbb Z}A\) to the source ambient algebra and the premise \(J_v=\Bbbk\otimes_{\mathbb Z}J_v^{\mathbb Z}\).
- As claim-4 correctly records, the supplied source only defines the characteristic-zero Bruhat span. It does not establish the Bruhat-to-partition correspondence or an integral form. Hence literal \(J_v=S\) is presently ill-typed and unproved; only the conditional ideal statement is established.
